thread:
maria: quick sync — Q3 perf roadmap decisions. customer asks piling up: ACME wants sub-300ms p99 for chat, BetaCorp pushing for 2x token cost reduction via quant. need to align on scope and launch criteria.

tian: short take: kernels + quant = biggest win but high risk. int8/in2 quant gives cost win but we need evals on hallucination/regressions. recommend pilot on 13B first.

alex: KV cache improvements are low-hanging: prefix caching + sticky routing could cut token compute by ~30% for chat flows. implementation is small, infra risk low.}

simon: can we rank by impact/effort? suggested OKRs: "2x throughput for interactive workloads", "30% unit cost reduction", "p99 < 300ms for hosted tier". What do we put in must-have vs nice-to-have?

tian: must-have: kernel microkernels for block-sparsity + safe quant infra (evaluate with calibration). nice-to-have: aggressive int4 rollout.

alex: must-have: KV cache sticky routing, batching improvements, tracing hooks for cache hit rates. nice-to-have: autoscaling tweaks for Dedicated.

maria: customers: ACME = latency priority (SLA), BetaCorp = cost priority (reserved). both are onboarding in next quarter. tradeoffs: lowering latency often increases cost.

simon: launch criteria proposal — for any perf change we require: 1) synthetic perf benchmarks, 2) customer-facing evals on 5 prompts, 3) rollback playbook, 4) monitoring alerts: p50/p95/p99 + quality regression >3% ops alert. agree?

tian: +1 on rollback playbook. add canary traffic at 10% for 48h and automated drift detection on logits-level metrics.

perf-bot: deploy-candidate created: perf/kernel-quant-pilot-177864 — canary set to 10%. (automated message)

maria: timeline check — Q3 sprint 1: KV caching + batching (MVP). sprint 2: kernel optimizations + safe quant pilot. sprint 3: customer pilots + rollouts.

simon: ask: where do we pull capacity for kernel work? do we deprioritize other infra tickets?

alex: propose carving 20% of runtime cycles for kernel/quant work and pausing non-critical telemetry cleanup tasks for one quarter.

tian: risk note: int8 pilot needs labeled reg test set > 2k prompts to measure quality drift. ops can we get that from BetaCorp + internal synth?

maria: @alex can you commit infra capacity? if yes, we mark kernel/quant as priority A.

alex: yes, I can free up 20% and allocate a small sproc pool for experiments.

simon: ok we have a path. next actions: (1) tian to write perf spec + eval plan by EOW, (2) alex to PR KV-cache prototype by Wed, (3) ops/perf-bot to schedule canary. everyone react with :thumbsup: if aligned.

maria: thanks — quick async wrap. :thumbsup:

(threads end)
